title: The corridor clears
speaker: X GOD
caption: The Pursuer fell behind us.
Dread Planet filled the sky.
alt: The familiar Starbreak ship leaves the defeated Pursuer's debris behind and approaches Dread Planet.

title: What paid for it
speaker: KILLER KAI · RADIO
caption: Earthior's gold. Their towers.
They built this place from stolen worlds.
alt: X and Z-God compare an Earthior cargo manifest with the gold-lit city below Dread Planet.

title: The next impact
speaker: NICO · RADIO
caption: He's arming another meteor.
The target is still Witchwood.
alt: A warning in the cockpit shows a meteor weapon arming for Witchwood, the refuge-world target found earlier.

title: At the source
speaker: X GOD
caption: Then we stop it at the source.
No more worlds. No more meteors.
alt: After landing, X and Z-God face the distant launch structure on Dread Planet.
